title.en: Electric 80 or Diesel 120 for an infrastructure distance?
title.zh: 基建距离选电动80还是柴油120？

description.en: Electric 80 is 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical at 60 m³/h on the grid and ≤ 2 cm stone. Diesel 120 is 150 m / 500 m at 100 m³/h off-grid, with ≤ 6 cm stone.
description.zh: 电动80是有电网、石子 ≤ 2 cm 时的水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、60 m³/h。柴油120是无电网的 150 m / 500 m、100 m³/h，石子 ≤ 6 cm。

h1.en: Electric 80 or Diesel 120 for an infrastructure distance?
h1.zh: 基建距离选电动80还是柴油120？

directAnswer.en: Choose by power and by which distance pair you measured. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 80 at 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical, 60 m³/h, 110 kW and ≤ 2 cm aggregate. Diesel 120 is 150 m horizontal / 500 m vertical, 100 m³/h, 290 kW of diesel and ≤ 6 cm aggregate. The selection guide names both for high-rise or long-distance conveying, then tells you to compare Electric 60 and HBT8018 as well. Neither page is a named project.
directAnswer.zh: 按动力和你量到的那一对距离来选。邢台河北品锦机械把电动80印成水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、60 m³/h、110 kW、骨料 ≤ 2 cm。柴油120是水平 150 m / 垂直 500 m、100 m³/h、柴油合计 290 kW、骨料 ≤ 6 cm。选型指南把两台都放在高层或长距离输送上，并让你同时比较电动60和 HBT8018。两页都不是具名项目。

heading.en: Do not mix the long side of each table
heading.zh: 不要各取每张表较长的一边

body.en: 900 m horizontal plus 500 m vertical is not a published machine. 100 m³/h is not printed on Electric 80. 60 m³/h is not the Diesel 120 cell. Stone limits also refuse the mix: 6 cm stone cannot use the Electric 80 row, and a site without 110 kW cannot use it either.
body.zh: 水平 900 m 再加垂直 500 m 不是一台已公布的机器。100 m³/h 没有印在电动80上。60 m³/h 不是柴油120的格子。石子上限也会拒绝这种混用：6 cm 石子不能用电动80那一行，没有 110 kW 的现场也不能用它。

heading.zh: 另外两个已公布的对照

body.en: Electric 60 prints fine-stone 200 m / 600 m at 40 m³/h on the grid. HBT8018 prints 60 m³/h, 150 m conveying and 450 m height at 132 kW, with 4 cm aggregate. The guide lists them beside Electric 80 and Diesel 120. Open the one whose power and stone exist on your site.
body.zh: 电动60在电网上把细石印成 200 m / 600 m、40 m³/h。HBT8018 印的是 60 m³/h、输送 150 m、高度 450 m、132 kW，骨料 4 cm。指南把它们和电动80、柴油120放在一起。打开你现场动力和石子对得上的那一台。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send four items: horizontal metres, vertical metres, maximum stone, and grid or diesel. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请发四项：水平米、垂直米、最大石子，以及电网或柴油。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Which has the longer horizontal cell?

answer.en: Electric 80, at 900 m. Diesel 120’s horizontal cell is 150 m.
answer.zh: 电动80，900 m。柴油120的水平格是 150 m。

question.en: Which has the higher vertical cell?

answer.en: Between these two, Diesel 120 prints 500 m. Electric 60’s fine-stone vertical is 600 m and is a third page.
answer.zh: 这两台之间，柴油120印了 500 m。电动60细石垂直是 600 m，那是第三页。

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h. 100 m³/h is Diesel 120.
answer.zh: 没有。电动80印的是 60 m³/h。100 m³/h 是柴油120。
